text: After a car accident kills his wife, Adam, a traditional religious healer, loses his faith and stops curing others. [His grief|who_suffers|the grieving] deepens until he meets Maria, a depressed woman who becomes [possessed by an evil spirit|threat|being taken over], and he must recite his prayers over her once more. When the village imam is found dead holding [a talisman|images|holy and occult objects] and old Pak Osman disappears, Adam begins to uncover links between Maria and [the crash that took his wife|wrong|a life taken].
